en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a festive street parade in a city center. People in traditional folk costumes march beneath a decorative archway resembling a stone gate, while crowds line the sidewalks and watch from building windows and balconies. Many commercial shop signs in Cyrillic script are visible on the façades. The large horizontal banner hanging from the arch is dated 1937 and other Cyrillic inscriptions appear on storefronts and placards.
